output.answer: As of November 11, 2026, Tesla (TSLA) has a market capitalization of roughly $1.55-1.56 trillion (GuruFocus: $1,551,616 million as of Nov. 11, 2026; StockAnalysis: $1.56T), with an enterprise value of about $1.53 trillion. The stock closed at $379.78 on Nov. 10, 2026 and was trading in the $386-395 range intraday on Nov. 11. Valuation multiples remain extremely rich: a trailing P/E of about 418-433 (well above its 10-year median of 179) and a forward P/E of about 184, on trailing-twelve-month revenue of $103.57 billion and net income of just $3.22 billion. GuruFocus pegs GF Value at $359.10 ("Fairly Valued"), while the average analyst 12-month price target is $412.48, only ~5% above the latest price.
caveats: Market cap and P/E are intraday figures that move with the share price; two aggregators the same day differ slightly (market cap $1,551,616 Mil vs $1.56T; trailing P/E 417.80 vs 432.53) due to different price snapshots and share-count conventions.

The trailing P/E (~418-433) is far above Tesla's 10-year median of 179.20 because TTM net income fell ~37% year over year; if earnings rebound, the multiple compresses quickly, and GuruFocus's own GF Value model labels the stock 'Fairly Valued' at $359.10 despite the elevated P/E.

Forward P/E of ~184 depends on analyst EPS forecasts, which can be revised; the market cap excludes any value of unannounced corporate actions and was computed while the market was open on Nov 11, 2026.
